title: Inlet Beach 306 W Park Place Avenue
h1: Inlet Beach 306 W Park Place Avenue
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Gorgeous gulf views- Spacious porches- Community pool- Natural gas grill- Outdoor shower- 5 adult bikes - Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Experience sun-soaked fun and lavish luxury at 306 W. Park Place. Located in Inlet Beach, this 5-bedroom, 5.5-bathroom home accommodates up to 15 guests across the street from the inviting Gulf. Enjoy a blissful getaway filled with beautiful beaches, towering dunes, flourishing natural beauty, and plenty of local watering holes and eateries to try. Imagine starting each morning by taking in the endless Gulf view from the balconies before strolling to the beach for a day of utter relaxation.Tastefully designed from top to bottom, the first level of this contemporary 3-story home hosts a charming bunk room with 2 twin-over-queen bunk beds and a lovely guest bedroom with a king bed, both with private bathrooms and Smart TVs. A laundry room is conveniently located off the hall.Ascend to the second floor, where the sunlit great room awaits. Dazzling blue Gulf views add a pop of color to the soothing palette of white shiplap walls and bleached hardwood floors. Chefs and guests who love to host will delight in the gorgeous kitchen, featuring high-end appliances—including a Wolf gas stove, SubZero wine cooler, and freestanding ice maker. After a day in the sun, cool off with a drink around the island/breakfast bar for 3 before digging into dinner at the table for 8. Along the back wall, the well-appointed living space with ample soft seating, a 75” Smart TV, and Sonos soundbar connects to a spacious balcony with a gas grill that overlooks the GulfContinue up the modern staircase—past a wall of picture windows—to find a second kid-friendly bunk room with 1 twin-over-queen bed, a guest bedroom with a queen bed and private bathroom, and the elegant primary bedroom with a Gulf view, private balcony, and private bathroom.With quick beach access, enthralling views, and a stunning interior, guests may never want to leave 306 W. Park Place. To leisurely explore, take advantage of the 5 complimentary adult bikes and parking for 3 vehicles in the driveway. Inlet Beach Regional Beach Access is directly across the street. Book this home for an unforgettable vacation today!SLEEPING ARRANGMENTS: (SLEEPS 15):FIRST FLOOR:Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyGuest Bedroom: 2 Twin-Over-Queen Bunk Beds, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlySECOND FLOOR:Main Living Area: Living Room, Kitchen, Dining AreaTHIRD FLOOR:Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only, Private BalconyGuest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyGuest Bedroom: Twin-Over-Queen Bunk Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo

body_text_excerpt: Destination Travel Collections Experiences + Services About Us Homeowners Travel Blog View Gallery Inlet Beach 306 W Park Place Avenue Inlet Beach, FL Short Term Rental #STR-126702 Bedrooms 5 Beds 9 Sleeps 15 Full Baths 5 Half Baths 1 HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Gorgeous gulf views - Spacious porches - Community pool - Natural gas grill - Outdoor shower - 5 adult bikes - Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, laundered upon every checkout DETAILS: Experience sun-soaked fun and lavish luxury at 306 W. Park Place. Located in Inlet Beach, this 5-bedroom, 5.5-bathroom home accommodates up to 15 guests across the street from the inviting Gulf. Enjoy a blissful getaway filled with beautiful beaches, towering dunes, flourishing natural beauty, and plenty of local watering holes and eateries to try. Imagine starting each morning by taking in the endless Gulf view from the balconies before strolling to the beach for a day of utter relaxation. Tastefully designed from top to bottom, the first level of this contemporary 3-story home hosts a charming bunk room with 2 twin-over-queen bunk beds and a lovely guest bedroom with a king bed, both with private bathrooms and Smart TVs. A laundry room is conveniently located off the hall. Ascend to the second floor, where the sunlit great room awaits. Dazzling blue Gulf views add a pop of color to the soothing palette of white shiplap walls and bleached hardwood floors. Chefs and guests who love to host will delight in the gorgeous kitchen, featuring high-end appliances—including a Wolf gas stove, SubZero wine cooler, and freestanding ice maker. After a day in the sun, cool off with a drink around the island/breakfast bar for 3 before digging into dinner at the table for 8. Along the back wall, the well-appointed living space with ample soft seating, a 75” Smart TV, and Sonos soundbar connects to a spacious balcony with a gas grill that overlooks the Gulf Continue up the modern staircase—past a wall of picture windows—to find a second kid-friendly bunk room with 1 twin-over-queen bed, a guest bedroom with a queen bed and private bathroom, and the elegant primary bedroom with a Gulf view, private balcony, and private bathroom. With quick beach access, enthralling views, and a stunning interior, guests may never want to leave 306 W. Park Place. To leisurely explore, take advantage of the 5 complimentary adult bikes and parking for 3 vehicles in the driveway. Inlet Beach Regional Beach Access is directly across the street. Book this home for an unforgettable vacation today!
